snippet.title: Gallipoli Launch Trailer - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3065940/Gallipoli/
Blackmill Games shared the launch trailer for its WW1 shooter Gallipoli during the Future Games Show at gamescom. It's a hyperrealistic military FPS where you brave the Ottoman Fronts, and it's out now on PC and console.
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
